home.title: MedQueue
home.tagline: See your place in the queue before you leave home.

empty.title: No doctors found
empty.body: Try a different district, or clear your search and browse nearby dispensaries.

login.title: Welcome
login.subtitle: Sign in with your mobile number to book and track dispensary tokens.
login.phoneHint: We'll send a 6-digit code by SMS. Standard rates apply.
login.codeHint: Sent to {phone}. It expires in 5 minutes.
login.pdpaConsent: I agree to MedQueue storing my details to manage my bookings, as described in the Privacy Policy.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.invalid_lk_mobile: Enter a valid Sri Lankan mobile number (07X XXX XXXX).
errors.otp_invalid: That code doesn't match. Check the SMS and try again.
errors.otp_expired_or_missing: That code has expired. Request a new one.
errors.otp_too_many_attempts: Too many tries. Request a new code.
errors.otp_rate_limited: Too many codes requested. Please wait a few minutes.
errors.pdpa_consent_required: Add your name and accept the privacy notice to create your account.
errors.account_disabled: This account is not active. Contact support for help.

errors.already_booked_this_session: You already hold a token for this session.
errors.max_active_bookings_reached: You can hold at most 3 active tokens. Cancel one to book again.

ticket.yourTurn: It's your turn — go in now
ticket.missed: Your token was called and skipped.
ticket.arriveHint: Leave for the dispensary when your wait drops below your travel time. Your position updates automatically.

empty.title: No tokens yet

payments.title: Payments

subscription.title: Monthly listing subscription
subscription.body: Keep your profile visible to patients. Pay online with PayHere, or transfer to our bank account and upload the slip for approval.

payments.slipHint: JPG, PNG, WEBP or PDF up to 5 MB. Approval usually takes less than one working day.
payments.slipUploaded: Slip received — we'll notify you once it's reviewed.
payments.slipBadType: That file type isn't supported. Upload a JPG, PNG, WEBP or PDF.
payments.slipTooLarge: That file is over 5 MB. Upload a smaller scan or photo.
payments.slipFailed: Upload failed. Check your connection and try again.
payments.noProfile: Complete your doctor registration before paying.
payments.checkoutFailed: Could not start the payment. Please try again.

empty.title: No payments yet
empty.body: Your subscription and listing payments will appear here.

return.title: Payment received by PayHere
return.body: We're confirming it with PayHere now. Your payment history will update within a minute or two.

cancelled.title: Payment cancelled
cancelled.body: No charge was made. You can try again, or upload a bank transfer slip instead.

ACTIVE.title: Reinstate this account?
ACTIVE.body: {name} will be able to sign in and book again immediately.

SUSPENDED.title: Suspend this account?
SUSPENDED.body: {name} will be signed out everywhere and blocked from booking until reinstated.

BANNED.title: Ban this account?
BANNED.body: {name} will be signed out everywhere and permanently blocked. This is recorded in the audit log.
